title.narrative: Sustainable Maritime Transport - Pacific

description.narrative: A five-year, multi-country initiative in Fiji, Tonga, and Vanuatu to decarbonize domestic maritime transport by delivering (i) national low-carbon maritime transport roadmaps, (ii) an integrated MRV (monitoring, reporting, verification) system for the sector, and (iii) an Alternate Marine Power (AMP) demonstration pilot, alongside an investment pipeline and targeted capacity building for government and private stakeholders. The project budget was framed in the PCP at approximately USD10 million, and in the Grant Arrangement at KRW 13.278 billion. GGGI is the implementing organization.

The overall objective is to prepare, enable, finance, and roll out low-carbon maritime transport in Fiji, Tonga, and Vanuatu by: (i) developing national roadmaps; (ii) designing and operationalizing an MRV system; (iii) piloting AMP to cut emissions from diesel gensets at port; (iv) building a pipeline of investments; and (v) strengthening institutional capacity.
